narrative:
Darke County has 33,927 registered voters, with 15.4% unaffiliated or lacking primary history. Republican-leaning voters make up 38.6% of registrants and Democratic-leaning voters account for 43.4%, a modest Democratic lean of 4.8 percentage points. Baby Boomers are the largest generational cohort at 29.2% of registrants.
